Docs/Getting started/Launch

Launch Dizel

Choose the desktop app or the terminal client. Both use the local engine and the checkpoint you pass them.

Use v1.5 today. The published checkpoint is checkpoints/dizel15/dizel-v15-distill-best.pt. The 1.6 preview has no weights.

Desktop app

The desktop app is an Electron shell over the local Python engine. The first run installs its own npm dependencies.

cd inference/gui
npm install
npm run dev

The app auto-detects a Python interpreter that can import FastAPI. Set DIZEL_PYTHON to override it.

Terminal UI

The TUI is keyboard-first and lives in the shell. It uses the same checkpoint and sidecar as the desktop app.

python -m inference.tui.main \
  --checkpoint checkpoints/dizel15/dizel-v15-distill-best.pt \
  --device cuda

Type /help for commands, /skills for prompt templates, and /mcp for plugin servers.

Headless generation

Send one prompt without opening a client. Tokens go to stdout; loader and error messages go to stderr.

python -m inference.tui.main \
  --checkpoint checkpoints/dizel15/dizel-v15-distill-best.pt \
  --device cuda \
  --prompt "Explain what a for loop does in one paragraph."
